try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)

blocked = any(x in cmd for x in ['npm run dev', 'npx vite', 'vite dev', 'yarn dev', 'pnpm dev'])
if blocked:
    print('\nBLOCKED: Do not start the UI dev server.\nAuthenticated routes require the backend stack.\nVerify with: npm run type-check and npm run build -- --mode production\n', file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
"
